## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the person running the experiment.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant behavior/edge-case tests pass.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check src tests scripts` passes.
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check src tests scripts` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/reproduce.py` passes, or expected-result changes are explained.
- [ ] Public data contains no keys, private documents or unsupported effectiveness claims.

## Experiment / compatibility impact

Note policy, seed, schema, payoff, metric or provider-contract changes. Explain any changed sample results and interpretation limits.
